# Third-party assets and notices

This project keeps the runtime libraries and the Latin font subsets local so the page does not need third-party script or font requests after deployment.

- **GSAP 3.12.5 and ScrollTrigger 3.12.5** — GreenSock. The original license/copyright banners are retained in `gsap.js` and `ScrollTrigger.js`. Review the applicable terms at https://gsap.com/standard-license before redistributing or using the libraries commercially.
- **Lenis 1.1.13** — MIT license; see `LICENSE-LENIS-MIT.txt`.
- **SplitType 0.3.4** — ISC license; see `LICENSE-SPLITTYPE-ISC.txt`. The package metadata identifies Luke Peavey as author.
- **Cormorant Garamond** — SIL Open Font License 1.1; see `OFL-CORMORANT-GARAMOND.txt`.
- **Jost** — SIL Open Font License 1.1; see `OFL-JOST.txt`.

The local font files are Latin subsets matching the characters used by this English-language page. If adding additional languages/scripts, obtain and include the correct font subsets and license notices rather than relying on these three Latin files.
